title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-9n2n: is_response_reuse is dead code — never called
description: is_response_reuse at lib.rs:1249 is defined but has zero callers anywhere in the codebase. It checks the response_window for replay detection of sent responses, but since it's never invoked, response replay protection via the response_window is non-functional. This is likely why the missing mark_response_used call in protect_response went unnoticed — the check was never wired up. The function should either be wired into the unprotect/verify path or removed to avoid confusion.
